about: Overwatch is an always-on and ever-evolving free-to-play, team-based hero shooter game set in an optimistic future, where every match is the ultimate 5v5 or 6v6 battlefield brawl featuring new heroes and maps, different ways to play, and unique cosmetics! Lead the charge, ambush your enemies, or aid your allies as one of Overwatch’s 40+ distinct heroes. Team up with friends, take them into battle across 25+ futuristic maps inspired by real-world locations, and master multiple unique game modes.
Reign of Talon - Season 5: A Grim Doctrine
Sink your teeth into a haunting new season as Doctrine escapes Grimsvotn, Halloween mayhem rises from the grave, and the Reign of Talon reaches its finale!

Something wicked this way comes... the wait is over! Doctrine emerges from the frozen depths of Grimsvotn and into the Support roster, bringing a deadly new philosophy of life, death, and everything worth taking in between. Follow his trail of destruction into the volcanic prison where Doomfist set him free on the first new Escort map since Overwatch 2 launched. As his escape unfolds, the Reign of Talon reaches its thrilling conclusion, years in the making.

Then raise some hell this Halloween with Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games, where every match is a fresh experiment in mayhem. The shadows hold even more surprises, as Sombra returns with a whole new bag of tricks as a Support alongside a reworked Roadhog. Resurrect Battle Passes past with Unvaulted Passes, embrace Mythic Wuyang's otherworldly power, and turn everything all the way up with Lucio's first Mythic Weapon, complete with our coolest custom audio and effects yet.
Beware. The final chapter is here.
